author: sonnet
label: climb-07r-01
changes: Moved the endpoint list and table/index definitions into the Terms section, so steps no longer need to define them.
Merged the 'Assumptions and open questions' heading into a single 'Open questions' section; the test checklist is now a separate 'Build and test checklist'.
Added a 'What happens when things fail' table, so the per-step failure bullets stay short.
Merged Page API / Queue / Storage terms to include limits stated elsewhere (45 s vs 60 s kill, 64 KB payload, 5 MB part minimum, 10,000 parts) and defined shared CSV writer and row_count as terms.
Added the missing started_at column to the table (it was used in step 6 but not listed).
Removed numeric step cross-references (e.g. 'step 7.7', 'step 6.3', 'step 3.5'); steps now refer to each other by name or in-step number only where unavoidable.
Merged the memory arithmetic and timing note of the streaming step into one 'Memory and time' line and dropped the duplicate in the test list wording.
Cut repeated explanations: the 'nothing visible until complete' idea is stated in terms and once in step 7; 'one at a time' reasoning stated once in the table/index and step 3.
Cut the step 9 sentence about step 10 leaving the export done (kept in step 10 and the failure table).
Restored out-of-scope line from the brief, which the first version dropped.
Merged the sub-steps of the small path (memory-in-response and the stop conditions) and the large path's retry rule; no mechanisms added.
